message.content:
In the community discussion, the idea of adding a small water feature to the garden was proposed by MuradinBronzebeard. He suggested adding a fountain or a pond to the seating area as a means to enhance the overall feel of the garden and attract wildlife. Additionally, ArthasMenethil supported this idea, mentioning that adding some rocks around the fountain would make it more inviting and blend well with the natural surroundings. 

Regarding outdoor games, the suggestion was made by RexxarRemar. He proposed that the addition of some games, particularly fun activities for children, would be a great way to ensure that the children enjoy their time in the garden and keep everyone engaged. Therefore, both MuradinBronzebeard and RexxarRemar brought up these ideas in the community discussion, aiming to improve the play area for children.
